name: Eventhouse
description: Eventhouse, a cutting-edge database workspace meticulously crafted to manage and store event-based data, is now officially available for general use. With Eventhouse, users can perform high-performance analysis of big data and real-time data querying, processing billions of events within seconds. The platform allows users to organize data into compartments (databases) within one logical item, facilitating efficient data management. Additionally, Eventhouse enables the sharing of compute and cache resources across databases, maximizing resource utilization.
